_comment: Location → pixel-art backdrop mapping for the Belgian Embassy case. Art is commissioned per case at 320x320 and lives under art/<case>/direct_pixel_art_v1/pixel_320x320/. The art assets are not yet on disk for this case; the filenames below name what is to be commissioned and will resolve once the assets are dropped in. _briefing is the establishing shot used at session open; _ending is the verdict card.

_npcs.presence:with_brennan: The cultural attache, 44, Irish-born. Charm worn as professional skill. Killer.
_npcs.presence:with_helena_voss: The ambassador's wife, 52. Forty-minute absence from the reception; witness to the tray intercept. Red herring.
_npcs.presence:with_catering_supervisor: The reception's catering supervisor. Noticed the forty-second interval and did not think it significant at the time.
_npcs.presence:with_ambassador_voss: The Belgian ambassador, Helena's husband. Diplomatic protocol made flesh; protective of his wife.
_npcs.presence:with_cipher_supervisor: Ilse's supervisor in the cipher room. Noted her pattern-recognition twice in her file and never acted on it.
_npcs.presence:with_embassy_doctor: The attending physician. Recorded cardiac arrest at ten forty-seven pm.
_npcs.presence:with_catering_runner: The catering staff member who carried the tray from the kitchen. Does not know what he carried.
_npcs.presence:with_press_attache: An embassy press attache who circulated through the reception. Useful for guest-position memory; not implicated.
_npcs.presence:with_chief_of_security: Embassy chief of security. Custodian of access logs and corridor footage; cooperative within his discretion.
_npcs.presence:with_kitchen_porter: Kitchen porter on the reception detail. Saw the trays loaded; did not see the corridor.

_objects.object:champagne_flute: The flute Ilse accepted at eight-fifteen pm. Found at ten forty-seven beside her chair.
_objects.object:catering_tray: The catering tray that crossed the corridor in forty seconds and arrived in the reception room with one position spoken for.
_objects.object:draft_report: Ilse's draft report. Left in a folder on her desk rather than in the locked drawer where she kept sensitive documents.
_objects.object:decoded_dispatch: The routine diplomatic communication Ilse decoded on November 28th. Names nothing on its face.
_objects.object:secondary_encoding_sheet: The layered secondary encoding inside the dispatch. Names a source. Names a date of activation: 1957.
_objects.object:duplicate_desk_key: A copy of Ilse's desk key, cut eighteen months earlier as a standard precaution by Brennan.
_objects.object:guest_list: The reception guest list. Sixty-three names. Four languages.
_objects.object:seating_plan: The seating plan. The conversations the guest list suggests were accidental, the seating plan confirms were deliberate.
_objects.object:post_mortem_panel: The post-mortem panel. Cardiac arrest. Tasteless. No marks. The compound does not appear here in 1961.
_objects.object:secondary_terminal_log: The cipher room's secondary terminal log. Helena's private communications, off the official log.
_objects.object:catering_timing_note: The catering supervisor's small daily timing note. Forty seconds recorded next to the tray that should have taken twenty.
_objects.object:signet_ring: Brennan's signet ring. He turns it on the third finger when answering questions about the corridor.
_objects.object:cipher_clerks_file: Ilse's personnel file. Two supervisor notes praising her pattern recognition. Neither acted on.

_locations_summary.location:reception_room: Ground floor, east wing. Sixty-three guests, four languages, crystal under chandeliers. Where the flute was accepted.
_locations_summary.location:kitchen_corridor: The forty-second corridor between the kitchen and the reception room. Brennan intercepted the tray here.
_locations_summary.location:embassy_kitchen: The reception's working kitchen. Trays loaded. The runner does not know what he carried.
_locations_summary.location:cipher_room: West wing, cold. Three years of Ilse's work. The dispatch was decoded here.
_locations_summary.location:document_room: Adjacent to the cipher room. Where Ilse was found at ten forty-seven pm.
_locations_summary.location:ambassadors_office: First floor, east wing. The ambassador's office. Helena's secondary terminal was here.
_locations_summary.location:east_wing_landing: The heated landing. The murmur of the reception carries up the stair.
_locations_summary.location:west_wing_stairwell: The cold stairwell. The approach to the cipher and document rooms.
_locations_summary.location:embassy_entrance: The Rue de la Loi entrance. Iron gate. Fog against the lamps.
_locations_summary.location:rue_de_la_loi: Outside, on the avenue. December fog. The case opens here at the door.
